# Fixture: colprof 生成 ICC Profile 成功完成
# 来源: 手写，基于 ArgyllCMS colprof 成功输出
# 工具版本: ArgyllCMS v2.2.x / v3.x
# 命令: colprof -v -qm -D "Display Profile" -al -yc output

# ========== colprof 成功输出 ==========
ArgyllCMS colprof - Profile generator
Version 2.2.1

Reading measurement data from 'output.ti3' ...
Loaded 1024 measurement points

Building forward lookup tables ...
Computing inverse lookup tables ...
Creating A2B0 table ...
Creating B2A0 table ...
Smoothing curves ...
Writing ICC profile ...

# ========== 完成输出 ==========
Created profile 'output.icc'

# ========== Profile 信息摘要 ==========
Profile description: 'Display Profile'
Profile type: Lab output profile
Profile class: Display
PCS: D50 Lab

# ========== ICC 标签信息 ==========
Tags included:
- desc: Profile description
- wtpt: White point
- rXYZ, gXYZ, bXYZ: Colorant XYZ
- rTRC, gTRC, bTRC: Tone reproduction curves
- A2B0: Device to PCS lookup table
- B2A0: PCS to Device lookup table
- (no VCGT due to -yc flag)

# ========== 预期解析结果 ==========
# 成功检测:
# - "Created profile" + ".icc" -> ICC 文件已生成
# - 返回码 = 0
# - 文件存在: output.icc
# - 文件大小 > 0 (通常几 KB 到几百 KB)
